units.source_text: 他从阿纳托尔·法朗士转向18世纪的哲学家，但是他没有靠近卢梭。

en.t: He turned from Anatole France toward the philosophers of the eighteenth century, but he did not draw near to Rousseau.

units.source_text: 那也许是他自己的一面——与卢梭相似的容易感情用事的一面。

en.t: Perhaps that was one side of himself: the side, like Rousseau, that was easily swept away by emotion.

units.source_text: 他却去靠近跟他自己的另一面——与写《天真汉》的那位哲学家相似的富于冷静的理智的一面。

en.t: Instead, he drew near to another side of himself: the side rich in cool reason, resembling the philosopher who wrote The Ingenuous Man.
